svg.text: Sheet 3 - ESP32 -> ISO7741 x3 -> MDD10A x3 -> 6 drive motors
- Dead isolator / lost PWM -> motor-side 10k pull-down
- Pull-downs live on the isolated (power) side: hold the
safe state even if clean domain / isolators are unpowered.
